evidence: The TiO2 thin films were deposited onto the substrates using [Ti(OCH(CH 3)2)4] (Aldrich; 99.999%) and H 2O as ALD precursors. 25 Ar served as both a carrier and a purging gas. The 7-octenyltrichlorosilane (7-OTS) and water were evaporated at 100 and 20 °C, respectively. Exposure times in this process wer e 5 s for 7-OTS with water vapor and 10 s for Ar purge. The terminal CdC groups of the SAM were converted to carboxylic groups with ozone treatment in the ALD chamber.
